Real Escape restored the persisted title without writing

Composition and settling Enter did not save or leave title; deliberate Enter after settling entered body
Multiline browser insertion in the middle normalized to spaces, kept caret after fragment and undid in one native undo
Real Ctrl+V clipboard paste normalized CRLF, preserved middle caret, and undid once
Ctrl+Y redid both normalized multiline insertion and real paste

Native maxLength admits 250 supplementary emoji within the server UTF-16 500-unit limit
Native maxLength caps 501 pasted Chinese characters at 500 units
